name.zh: 勇者之塔 第55层 哈尔浮、巴洛卡

location.zh: 精灵太空站 资源区 勇者之塔

reward_note: Floors 51-59 rewards are not listed in the source (未注明); none encoded.

capture.zh: 勇者之塔第55层：哈尔浮、巴洛卡（??级，多只连战）。

strategy_notes.zh: 两只电系（如希拉和雷伊）过关不难；哈尔浮速度很快

engine_notes: Remake progression (V53/V54): floors are climbed in order from the ten-floor starting points 1, 11, …, 61; a loss, retreat or cancelled load keeps the attempted floor, and the party may recover between floors. The 2010 tower allowed no healing between floors and sent a loser back to floor 1 (4399 2010-04-13: 如果挑战失败，要重新从一层开打); fleeing kept progress (只剩一只精灵时除非胜券在握，最好逃跑).
Level shown as '??' (4399: 31~60层…等级都是能力高于100的??、???级，比玩家精灵高二十、三十级). Encoded as Lv120 for 31-50 and Lv130 for 51-60 (20-30 above the Lv100 cap).
HP 1000 per monster from the T客邦 2011-01-19 floor table (TW server).
Multi-monster floor: the enemy fields its team one at a time (51-60层的怪都是两只以上一起上); win = KO all.
哈尔浮 (team[0]): moves first even against priority-2 闪光一击; skills used on it keep 70% accuracy (4399, TW 2011).
巴洛卡 (team[1]): unlimited PP; crit rate 25% (TW 2011).
source_note: 4399 勇者之塔1-60层 (2010-04) and 51-60层精灵大揭秘 (2009-12-28): line-ups, 60F rule and 肯 reward.
